structured_output.summary: I found no unmet criterion and no weakened test, and my probes passed. The integration probes cover ACC1 and ACC3 to ACC7. ACC8's HTTP/1.1 detached upgrade is probed, but the h2 extended CONNECT half is not, because it needs a GODEBUG child-process server; the task's own TestExtendedConnectH2 covers it. The ACC6 probe covers only the recorder; the encode writer's guard is covered only through the integration test. ACC9 and ACC10 have unit probes. Two small advisories.

findings.text: No test covers detached streams to dynamic upstreams, which are keyed by an empty string and so never closed on upstream removal. The doc comment states this limit, but the behaviour has no test.
gracefulClose calls markResult(reload) even on the detached close path, where closeUpstream has already marked the result; it is harmless because the first mark wins, but it reads as redundant.

coverage.note: The probe reloads with a changed handler chain and the same upstream, waits past the grace period, then echoes again.
The probe reloads a non-detached stream with a 2s delay: it still echoes during the delay and closes after about 2s.
The probe counts 101 access-log entries: none with skip_handshake, one by default.
The probe checks the close entry's level: warn when configured, debug by default, and no entry when the access logger is at INFO.

The probe covers the recorder only: after Hijack, WriteHeader, Write and Flush are dropped or rejected and the client sees only the 101 plus the raw bytes. The encode writer is covered only through the integration test.
The probe runs a websocket upgrade through encode and intercept with access logging; it echoes, has no Content-Encoding on the 101, and the close is logged.

The probe covers the HTTP/1.1 upgrade in detached mode through encode and intercept. The h2 extended CONNECT half is not probed, because it needs a GODEBUG child-process server; TestExtendedConnectH2 covers it.
The probe runs 20 concurrent markResult and finish calls and checks active is 0, exactly one close counted, and the byte counters are 7 and 9.
The probe marshals the parsed Handler to JSON and checks the three new fields, and checks four invalid inputs return errors.
